ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Spin it, and spin it... Like this, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Крути, крути... Вот так, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Yes, that looks good. Next...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Да, так хорошо. Дальше...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: What's this? Firis is learning alchemy from Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Что это? Фирис учится алхимии у Плахты?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Wow, yeah! But isn't Firis Sophie's student?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ого, да! Но разве Фирис не ученица Софи?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hey, you two. That's right, I'm Miss Sophie's student.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Эй, вы двое. Верно, я ученица госпожи Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: But since that also makes her the student of my student, I sometimes also teach Firis myself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Но раз она ещё и ученица моей ученицы, я иногда сама тоже учу Фирис.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Plachta can teach really well. It goes without saying that she's a great alchemist, too.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Плахта очень хорошо объясняет. Само собой, она ещё и великий алхимик.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Wow! She does look like she'd be good at taking care of people.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ого! По ней и правда видно, что она умеет заботиться о людях.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hehe, thank you. But please don't tell Sophie about this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Хе-хе, спасибо. Но пожалуйста, не говорите об этом Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: What? Why not? It's not like you're doing anything wrong...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Что? Почему? Вы же ничего плохого не делаете...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Haha, well, it makes her jealous.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха-ха, ну... она начинает ревновать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: If I teach Firis, Sophie gets mad and starts going on about how she's Firis' teacher.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Если я учу Фирис, Софи злится и твердит, что учительница Фирис — она.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Honestly. She's a grown woman now, but inside she's still just a kid.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Честно. Она уже взрослая женщина, а внутри всё ещё ребёнок.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hahaha, she still relies on you a lot, Sophie!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, она всё ещё сильно на вас полагается, Софи!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Oh, you bet she does. Sometimes I think she'd do better without...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: О, ещё как. Иногда думаю, ей было бы лучше без...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Plachta! I've baked some cookies! Let's have some tea!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Плахта! Я испекла печенье! Давайте выпьем чаю!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Yes, I'm coming! Sorry, girls, but it's time for tea.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Да, иду! Простите, девочки, пора пить чай.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Sophie, what's on the menu for today?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Софи, что сегодня в меню?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Some of my special cakes, and some lemon tea too!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Мои фирменные пирожные и лимонный чай!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: She just stopped mid-sentence and went off to eat, didn't she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Она просто оборвала фразу на полуслове и ушла есть, да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hahaha, this might sound odd coming from me, but Plachta's first loyalty is to her stomach!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, странно слышать это от меня, но первая верность Плахты — желудку!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hah, that's unexpected! I guess Plachta might also be more of a little kid than I thought!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха, неожиданно! Похоже, Плахта тоже больший ребёнок, чем я думала!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Hello, Plachta. Fancy a little friendly competition?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Здравствуй, Плахта. Не хочешь небольшое дружеское соревнование?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Very well. What do you propose?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Хорошо. Что предлагаешь?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Hahaha! Nothing less than a test of alchemy knowledge!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Ничего меньше, чем проверка знаний по алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: You've got guts, Suelle. Thinking you can compete with me in alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Смелая ты, Сюэль. Думаешь соревноваться со мной в алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Oh no, I'm not going to be your opponent. Ta-dah! Lydie is!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: О нет, я не буду твоим соперником. Та-да! Им будет Лиди!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: What? Me? Me?! This is the first I'm hearing about this!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Что? Я? Я?! Впервые об этом слышу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: It just suddenly came to me! You like to read a lot, right Lydie?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Просто внезапно осенило! Ты же любишь много читать, да, Лиди?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: So maybe you can give Plachta a run for her money!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Так что, может, сможешь дать Плахте настоящий бой!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: I don't have your confidence! I'm sorry, Plachta. I forfeit to you, of course.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: У меня нет твоей уверенности! Прости, Плахта. Я, конечно, сдаюсь тебе.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: No, I don't accept that. Let's do this. I like a good challenge!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Нет, не принимаю. Давайте. Мне нравится хороший вызов!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: No need to get quite so excited! Very well, I'll do it...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Не надо так возбуждаться! Ладно, я сделаю это...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Question 1! Is puni fluid acid or alkaline?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Вопрос первый! Жидкость пуни — кислота или щёлочь?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Alkaline.<CR>Alkaline!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Щёлочь.<CR>Щёлочь!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Alkaline!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Щёлочь!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Correct! What does "alkaline" mean again?... Anyway, next question! Spines of an uni are always...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Верно! А что значит «щёлочь»?... Впрочем, следующий вопрос! Шипы уни всегда...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: A multiple of four.<CR>A multiple of four!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Кратны четырём.<CR>Кратны четырём!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: A multiple of four!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Кратны четырём!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Another correct answer from you both! Who counted them, anyway? On to question three...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ещё один правильный ответ от обеих! Кто их вообще считал? К вопросу три...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Uwah, I knew I'd lose. There was no way I could hope to win!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ух, я знала, что проиграю. Шансов на победу не было!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Not at all, Lydie. I'm impressed. You've acquired much knowledge for your young age.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Вовсе нет, Лидия. Я впечатлена. Для своего возраста ты накопила много знаний.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: You should be more confident. Your daily studies will surely pay off.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Будь увереннее в себе. Ежедневные занятия обязательно окупятся.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Plachta! Thank you. I'll try to keep it up!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Плахта! Спасибо. Постараюсь не сдаваться!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Wow. I can never tell them that I didn't know most of the answers to the questions I was asking.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ого. Никогда не признаюсь им, что не знала большинства ответов на свои же вопросы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Right... I'm going to forget today ever happened. So, what to eat tomorrow? Hahaha!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ладно... Забуду, что сегодня было. Итак, что съесть завтра? Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Plachta! Plachta! We've got a question for you!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Плахта! Плахта! У нас к тебе вопрос!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Can we watch you while you do some alchemy?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Можем посмотреть, как ты занимаешься алхимией?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Well, what do you think? You're Sophie's teacher, after all!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Ну, как думаешь? Ты же учительница Софи!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: You must be quite the alchemist! Do you mix while standing on your head? Ooh, tell me that you do!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Ты, должно быть, настоящий алхимик! Смешиваешь стоя на голове? Ох, скажи, что да!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Girls. I'm an alchemist, not a clown!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Девочки. Я алхимик, а не клоун!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Also, I'm sorry to betray your expectations, but I can't actually synthesize.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: И простите, что обману ваши ожидания, но я на самом деле не могу синтезировать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: What? You can't?! What do you mean?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Exactly what it sounds like. There's a reason why I can't make items.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Именно так, как звучит. Есть причина, почему я не могу создавать предметы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Really? But you know so much about alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Правда? Но ты так много знаешь об алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Of course, I used to synthesize in the past. But since I've had this body...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Конечно, раньше я синтезировала. Но с тех пор как у меня это тело...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Yeah... I don't think we should stick our noses in this one...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Да... Кажется, не стоит совать нос сюда...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Plachta, thank you. Sorry for asking something so weird.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Плахта, спасибо. Прости, что спросила что-то такое странное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: No, that's fine. I can offer you some advice about alchemy, instead.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Нет, всё в порядке. Вместо этого могу дать вам советы по алхимии.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Wow, are you sure? That would be great!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Ого, правда? Это было бы здорово!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Without further delay, then. The secret to thinking up recipes...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Тогда без проволочек. Секрет придумывания рецептов...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hmm. Which should I read next?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хм. Что прочитать дальше?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hey, Plachta. Are you choosing a book?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Эй, Плахта. Выбираешь книгу?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Yes. I love to read. Would you both care to join me?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Да. Я люблю читать. Не хотите присоединиться?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha, I thought you'd never ask! No running away, Sue, please!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я думала, ты никогда не предложишь! Не убегай, Сью, пожалуйста!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Gyah! She caught me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Гьях! Поймала...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Of course I did. I'm your sister!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Конечно. Я же твоя сестра!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Plachta was kind enough to ask us to join her! A little reading will do you some good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Плахта любезно пригласила нас! Немного чтения тебе не повредит.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Ugh... fine! But just a little, okay?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Угх... ладно! Но совсем чуть-чуть, хорошо?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hmm. You may not like reading, Suelle, but you handle those books with care.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хм. Читать ты, Сюэль, может, и не любишь, но с книгами обращаешься бережно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Of course. Just because I hate something, it doesn't mean I'm going to throw it around!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Конечно. Если я что-то ненавижу, это не значит, что буду этим швыряться!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Promise with Mom Number 3! "Handle books with care"!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Обещание маме номер три! «Бережно обращайся с книгами»!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha... That one only came about because you always used to leave books lying around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Оно появилось только потому, что ты вечно оставляла книги где попало...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: I was a baby! I look after books now by keeping them safe on the shelf at all times.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Я была маленькой! Теперь я храню книги — всегда на полке.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hah! You get bored too easily, Sue.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха! Ты слишком быстро скучаешь, Сью.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hehe. In any case, I'm impressed to see you looking after books so well.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хе-хе. В любом случае, приятно видеть, как ты так хорошо заботишься о книгах.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Eating while reading, or folding page corners, I cannot abide people who do such things!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Есть за чтением или загибать уголки страниц — таких людей я не терплю!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha! Plachta, you sound like a book yourself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Плахта, ты сама говоришь как книга.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: With good reason, I assure you. I was a book, once.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: И на то есть причина, уверяю. Когда-то я была книгой.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: ... What?! You were a book?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: ...Что?! Ты была книгой?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hey, Lydie... Plachta says the weirdest things sometimes, doesn't she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Эй, Лиди... Плахта иногда говорит самые странные вещи, да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Yeah... Is she simply joking? She doesn't look like the type to joke around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ага... Она просто шутит? Не похоже, что она из тех, кто шутит...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: I know. But I can't believe that's true, either... Hmm?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Знаю. Но и поверить в это тоже не могу... Хм?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Girls? Is something wrong?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Девочки? Что-то не так?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Ah! No, it's nothing. We're fine.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ах! Нет, ничего. У нас всё в порядке.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Just... wanna...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Просто... хочу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: W-What's got into both of you? Why are you staring at me like that?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ч-что на вас нашло? Почему так на меня смотрите?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Well... After looking at you closely, we can really see how your body is a doll...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ну... Если присмотреться, правда видно, что тело у тебя кукольное...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: You've got that tail going on, of course, and those cool parts stuck to your back...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Вон этот хвост, конечно, и эти крутые штуки на спине...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: What does it feel like, I wonder? Can I touch you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Интересно, каково это на ощупь? Можно потрогать?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: O-Of course not! How embarrassing. Please excuse me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: К-конечно нет! Как стыдно. Прошу прощения!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Ah, hold on!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ах, стой!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Hey! Don't grab that! Don't grab my tail! And it's not a tail either, it's an important piece of...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Эй! Не хватай это! Не хватай меня за хвост! И это не хвост, а важная деталь...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Heh, it looks like a tail to me... So, Plachta...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Хех, по-моему, это хвост... Итак, Плахта...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Just what can your body do? I've seen you eating stuff, like cookies... Do you use the toilet?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Что вообще может твоё тело? Я видела, как ты ешь печенье... Ты ходишь в туалет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Are you soft? Or unexpectedly hard? Please, let me touch you! Just a little!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ты мягкая? Или неожиданно твёрдая? Пожалуйста, дай потрогать! Чуть-чуть!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: W-What's with you both?! Please, stay back!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ч-что с вами обеими?! Пожалуйста, отойдите!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Sophie! Sophie! Save me! Please, save me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Софи! Софи! Спаси меня! Пожалуйста, спаси!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Bah! But I still have loads of questions...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ба! А у меня ещё куча вопросов...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: I just wanted to poke her tummy a little... That's all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Мне просто хотелось чуть потыкать ей животик... Вот и всё.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: What are you talking about? Lydie and Sue? That doesn't sound much like them.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: О чём ты? Лиди и Сью? На них не похоже.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: It is! It's exactly like them! Those two little monsters!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Именно они! Точно они! Эти два маленьких монстра!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Hmm, it feels like I've seen this before somewhere?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Хм, будто я уже где-то это видела?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: It can't be helped that they're inquisitive, anyway. I had all sorts of questions myself, haha...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Впрочем, ничего не поделаешь — они любопытные. У меня самой была куча вопросов, ха-ха...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I'm going to try again. Just asking can't hurt! Plachta, how old are you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Попробую ещё раз. Спросить же не вредно! Плахта, сколько тебе лет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sue! I know this is an interesting topic, but I think you're starting to bother the poor woman!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Сью! Тема интересная, но, кажется, ты начинаешь докучать бедной женщине!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Asking her age is very rude, too. I'm sorry, Plachta.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Спрашивать возраст тоже очень грубо. Прости, Плахта.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hold on, I want to know the answer! All this talk about "long ago"... Well, how long?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Стой, я хочу знать ответ! Всё это «давным-давно»... Ну и как давно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hehe, I don't mind answering this one. My age? I am...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Хе-хе, на этот вопрос не против ответить. Мой возраст? Мне...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sixteen.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Шестнадцать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: This body was made to look sixteen. And a doll body does not age.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Это тело сделали на вид шестнадцатилетним. А кукольное тело не стареет.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Therefore, I am sixteen. So long as I am in this body, I will be sixteen forever!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Значит, мне шестнадцать. Пока я в этом теле — мне вечно будет шестнадцать!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sounds like cheating to me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: По-моему, это читерство...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: What is it actually? About 520? A bit more?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: А на самом деле? Около пятисот двадцати? Чуть больше?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sophie! Why did you have to ruin it?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Софи! Зачем ты всё испортила?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sorry, but I can't just sit by while a friend so fiendishly covers up her age...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Прости, но не могу спокойно сидеть, пока подруга так коварно скрывает возраст...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: 520! That's like, a super granny! The grandma among grandmas!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: 520! Это ж супербабушка! Бабушка среди бабушек!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Ah... I wouldn't throw terminology like that around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эх... Я бы такими словами не разбрасывалась...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: It's all right. I'm definitely an old maid, however you count it.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ничего. Я определённо старая дева — как ни считай.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: A stubborn, set-in-her ways, always complaining, eccentric old granny, that's me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Упрямая, закоснелая, вечно ворчащая эксцентричная старая бабушка — вот кто я!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Oh dear, you've done it now... Girls, please, try and change the subject!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: О боже, теперь ты влипла... Девочки, пожалуйста, смените тему!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Okay, okay... I know! Plachta, I've got another question!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ладно, ладно... Знаю! Плахта, у меня ещё вопрос!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: You've been a book, and now a doll... Do you want to become human again?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ты была книгой, а теперь кукла... Хочешь снова стать человеком?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes. Of course I do. But there's also no hurry.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да. Конечно хочу. Но и спешить некуда.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I have complete faith in Sophie, and she'll be able to turn me back, one day.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Я полностью верю в Софи — однажды она сможет вернуть меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Uwah! Plachta, you really do trust Sophie...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ух! Плахта, ты и правда так доверяешь Софи...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes. Even if she does go around spilling all my secrets.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да. Даже если она разбалтывает все мои секреты.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Ah, I'm going to pay for that one later... That's the problem with the elderly!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эх, за это мне потом достанется... Вот беда со стариками!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: What?! Another kick while I'm down! And you dare to address your teacher in such a way!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Что?! Ещё и пнуть лежащую! И так смеешь обращаться к своей учительнице!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hahaha, Sophie and Plachta really are such good friends!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, Софи и Плахта и правда такие хорошие подруги!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I've never seen two people who seem to be having so much fun when they are fighting.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Никогда не видела двух людей, которым так весело, когда они ссорятся.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: You're such a slob, too! Look, I can see your underwear again!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ты тоже такая неряха! Смотри, снова видно бельё!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hey, you don't have to say that with them here! And you're one to talk about showing off...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эй, не обязательно говорить это при них! И тебе ли говорить о том, что светить...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: How many times do I have to tell you?! After you've used something, put it back!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Сколько раз повторять?! После использования клади на место!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Gah! I was just placing it somewhere I can easily find it again, that's all...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Гах! Я просто положила туда, где потом легко найти, вот и всё...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Ah, Sophie is getting chewed out again...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ах, Софи опять отчитывают...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hahaha... I've seen that so often, I'm starting to think it's just a routine in this atelier.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Видела это так часто, что начинаю думать — это просто рутина ателье.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Great timing, girls! Take care of Plachta, will you? Later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Как раз вовремя, девочки! Присмотрите за Плахтой, ладно? Пока!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hey, wait! Gah, she's gone. Always so fast to run away!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Эй, стой! Гах, ушла. Всегда так быстро сбегает!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Sorry about that. It looks like our timing was off?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Извини. Похоже, мы не вовремя?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: No, it's fine. Hehehe. We can just start from the beginning when she gets back.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Нет, всё в порядке. Хе-хе-хе. Когда вернётся — начнём сначала.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Uwah! Cold hearted!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ух! Какая жестокость!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: It's not like I'm lecturing her for my own enjoyment.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Я не отчитываю её ради собственного удовольствия.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: While Sophie's alchemy may have grown in leaps and bounds, her general living skills are still poor.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Алхимия Софи выросла семимильными шагами, а вот бытовые навыки всё ещё слабы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: If I can't change this, she'll become a worthless old lady who's only saving grace is her alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Если не исправить это, она станет никчемной старушкой, чья единственная отрада — алхимия!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I want her to be happy, that's all. So she needs to be able to do more than just alchemy...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Я просто хочу, чтобы она была счастлива. Значит, ей нужно уметь больше, чем алхимию...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I see... So that's the reason behind all of your lecturing.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Понятно... Вот в чём причина всех твоих нотаций.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hahaha! Plachta, it's like you're her mother!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Плахта, ты словно её мама!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: M-Mother?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: М-мама?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I've been called "elderly" and "granny" and all sorts in the past...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Меня уже звали «пожилой», «бабушкой» и всяким таким...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: But this is the first time I've been called a "mother". Wow, this one might be really getting to me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Но «мамой» — впервые. Ого, кажется, это меня и правда задевает...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Really? Hehe, Mother Plachta! I think it quite suits you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Правда? Хе-хе, матушка Плахта! Думаю, тебе идёт.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: S-Stop that! I think I'd rather be treated like a frail old lady than be called "mother"!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: П-прекратите! Лучше уж обращайтесь со мной как с хрупкой старушкой, чем зовите «мамой»!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Both of you, don't call me that again! Understand?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Вы обе — больше так не называйте! Поняли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Okay! No problem, Mommy Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ладно! Без проблем, мамочка Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Suelle, time for one of my famous lectures. All of your dreams are about to come true!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Сюэль, время одной из моих знаменитых лекций. Все твои мечты вот-вот сбудутся!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Oh no, I went too far! Run for it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: О нет, я зашла слишком далеко! Бежим!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hey, Sue! Ah, Plachta, see you later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Эй, Сью! Ах, Плахта, увидимся!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I can hardly keep up with those two, honestly...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Честно говоря, я едва за ними успеваю...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Oh? Welcome, you two. Would you like some tea?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Ой? Добро пожаловать, вы двое. Хотите чаю?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Are you all right, Plachta?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: С тобой всё в порядке, Плахта?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: ... I am sorry. It's embarrassing, but I'm not very used to this body yet...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: ...Простите. Стыдно признать, но я ещё плохо привыкла к этому телу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: It's been 500 years since I had a human one. I can't seem to find the right balance...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Прошло 500 лет с тех пор, как у меня было человеческое. Не могу найти правильный баланс...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Oh... I guess a doll's body and a human one must be pretty different...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Ох... Наверное, кукольное тело и человеческое сильно отличаются...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: By the way, how does it even feel, having a doll's body? Were your joints like all hard?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Кстати, каково это — иметь кукольное тело? Суставы были твёрдыми?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Not at all. It was a work of a master, after all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Совсем нет. Всё-таки работа мастера.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Even if there were times when I would injure it, it never failed me otherwise.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Даже если иногда я его повреждала, в остальном оно меня никогда не подводило.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Hmmmm. Does that mean that a human body is actually less comfortable?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Хммм. Значит, человеческое тело на самом деле менее удобное?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Ahaha, well, I wouldn't say that... I am simply not used to it yet.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Аха-ха, ну я бы так не сказала... Просто ещё не привыкла.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: But this body does... how should I say it... "fit better"? I guess.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Но это тело... как бы сказать... «сидит лучше»? Наверное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: "Fit better"?... I can't even begin to understand...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: «Сидит лучше»?... Я даже представить не могу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: That is natural. Usually, humans do not get to experience having more than one kind of body, after all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Это естественно. Обычно людям не доводится иметь больше одного вида тела.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Well, when I first got my doll body it didn't take that much to get used to it. So I think it won't be long now...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Когда я впервые получила кукольное тело, привыкнуть было не так уж трудно. Так что, думаю, и сейчас недолго...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Yeah, my favorite student made this body for me after all, and I want to use it freely as soon as I can... Ohoh.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Да, моя любимая ученица всё-таки сделала это тело для меня, и я хочу свободно им пользоваться как можно скорее... Ох.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Uh? That was some nasty noise. Ahh! The flask is in shards!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Э? Какой-то противный звук. Ах! Колба в осколках!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: I think it got crushed under Plachta's bottom... Hip-crusher Plachta... A technique to fear...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Кажется, её раздавило под задом Плахты... Бедродробилка Плахта... Техника, которой стоит бояться...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Hip-crusher?! Don't give me any weird nicknames!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Бедродробилка?! Не давайте мне странных прозвищ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Yeah, I mean her hips are pretty big... Oh. No. I mean... ! Ugh, well, we'll be going now! Bye!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Да, ну у неё бёдра довольно... Ох. Нет. То есть...! Ух, мы пойдём! Пока!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Wait right there! Mocking my complexes... You'll get an earful yet!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Стойте где стоите! Издеваетесь над моими комплексами... Ещё получите!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Waaah! She can run just fine! I think we've inspired her to master her new body!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Вааа! Она отлично бегает! Кажется, мы вдохновили её освоить новое тело!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Run for it! She'll spank us for sure if she catches up!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Бежим! Если догонит — точно отшлёпает!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Girls! I won't forgive you easily for this! Get back here!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Девочки! Я вам это так просто не прощу! Вернитесь сюда!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Hey, girls! I've been waiting for you!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: You have? Some kind of emergency job?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Was that your tummy rumbling, Plachta? That means...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Это у тебя в животе урчало, Плахта? Значит...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: That's right. It's been a long time since I experienced rumbling like this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Верно. Давно я не испытывала такого урчания.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Since becoming human again, everything I eat is just so delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: С тех пор как снова стала человеком, всё, что ем, такое вкусное!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: So I want both of you to feed me with the most delicious stuff you can find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Поэтому хочу, чтобы вы обе накормили меня самым вкусным, что найдёте!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Hahaha, I guess that makes sense. You can leave this to us, then!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, логично. Тогда оставь это нам!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: We'll bring enough food to feed you ten times over!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: As quickly as possible, please. Hehehe!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: I'm so hungry, the two of you are starting to look quite delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Я так голодна, что вы двое начинаете выглядеть аппетитно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Uwaaah! We'll be quick, we promise, just don't eat us!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Увааа! Будем быстрыми, обещаем, только не ешь нас!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta! We've got some of the most delicious food we could find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта! Мы принесли самое вкусное, что смогли найти!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: This should fill you up, Plachta! Go ahead, eat...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Этого должно хватить, Плахта! Давай, ешь...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Phew, thanks. That was all very good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Уф, спасибо. Всё было очень вкусно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What! You've finished already?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что! Ты уже всё съела?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I-I think I blinked and missed it! Is this what happens when you go hungry for 500 years?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: К-кажется, я моргнула и пропустила! Вот что бывает, когда голодаешь 500 лет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: The 500 Years' Hunger! Yes, I might enter an eating contest under that name.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Голод пятисот лет! Да, под таким именем я могла бы выйти на конкурс едоков.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hahaha. You'll probably face Firis in the final!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха. В финале, наверное, встретишься с Фирис!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Probably. Anyway, recently, eating has been giving me much joy.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Наверное. В общем, в последнее время еда приносит мне много радости.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Being able to truly enjoy delicious food might be the best thing about becoming human again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: По-настоящему наслаждаться вкусной едой, возможно, лучшее в возвращении к человеческому облику.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I did eat while I was a doll, after all, but I couldn't taste the food.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Куклой я тоже ела, но вкуса не чувствовала.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I see, I see... A bit of indulging now isn't going to hurt, then, is it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Понятно, понятно... Тогда немного побаловать себя сейчас не повредит, да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hmm...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What is it, Suelle? Have I got some food stuck on my face?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что такое, Сюэль? У меня еда на лице?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: No, but I was just thinking... Have you put on a little weight, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Нет, просто подумала... Ты не поправилась немного, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hey, now that you mention it... You do look a little plumper!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Эй, теперь когда ты сказала... И правда выглядишь чуть полнее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Y-You might be right... I have been feeling heavier recently.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: М-может, ты и права... В последнее время чувствую себя тяжелее.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I overlooked that point. Completely forgot about it! A human body gets larger, doesn't it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Упустила этот момент. Совсем забыла! Человеческое тело ведь увеличивается, да!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: It's much easier to put it on that it is to take it off.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Набрать куда проще, чем сбросить.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Uwah! Is the human body so cruel?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ух! Неужели человеческое тело так жестоко?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What can I do?! I want to eat, but I don't want to get fat!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что делать?! Хочу есть, но не хочу толстеть!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sophie! Sophie! Answer me! Give me the answer!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Софи! Софи! Ответь мне! Дай ответ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta... That's a battle that every human has to fight for themselves...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта... Это битва, которую каждый человек ведёт сам...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: That's the truth of life, Plachta. You're living it now.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Вот правда жизни, Плахта. Ты сейчас в ней живёшь.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sue, I think that might be going a little far!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Сью, мне кажется, это уже чересчур!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh... My back is killing me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Угх... Спина убивает.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Eh?! Are you alright? Did you sprain it?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Э?! Ты в порядке? Растянула?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: No way! I'm not that old yet! I just spent a bit too long at my desk last night...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ни за что! Я ещё не настолько стара! Просто вчера слишком долго сидела за столом...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh... Well, maybe you just need a massage? I could help you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ох... Может, нужен массаж? Я могла бы помочь.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I'm actually pretty good at it! Sometimes I even get asked by our neighbors...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: У меня это неплохо получается! Иногда даже соседи просят...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Really? Well, if you don't mind...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Правда? Ну, если не сложно...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Sophie? Sorry, I think I'll need my usual maintenance...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Софи? Прости, кажется, мне нужно обычное обслуживание...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ahahaha! Maintenance? You're a human now!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Аха-ха-ха! Обслуживание? Ты теперь человек!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ah... Right. Sorry, of course you're right...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ах... Точно. Прости, конечно, ты права...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Heh... That heavenly ticklish feeling... I guess I'll never get to experience that again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Хех... То божественное щекотное чувство... Кажется, больше мне его не испытать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: She looks pretty disappointed about that. Does maintenance really feel that good?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Она выглядит очень разочарованной. Обслуживание и правда так приятно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wonder... It's not like we can do it to humans... Hm?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Интересно... С людьми так не сделаешь... Хм?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh! I've got it! Your offer of a massage. I think there's someone better to...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ой! Поняла! Твоё предложение массажа. Думаю, есть кто-то, кому он нужнее...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Aaaaahhhh...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ааааааа...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehehe, does it really feel that good, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхе-хе, неужели так хорошо, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It does... It really does... It feels the best...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да... Правда да... Лучше всего на свете...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Wow. That's some face, Plachta! Lydie must be really good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ого. Вот это лицо, Плахта! Лиди, должно быть, очень хороша.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh, I think I'm getting envious. Lydie! I want one too, after all!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Угх, кажется, я завидую. Лиди! Я тоже хочу, в конце концов!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Okaay! Just give me a few minutes here. ...Hn! This should be a good spot!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ладно! Дай мне тут пару минут. ...Хн! Вот хорошее место!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! Amazing... you're amazing, Lydie! I can't... think anymore...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Потрясающе... ты потрясающая, Лиди! Я не могу... больше думать...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehhehe! That's right, that's right. And for the finish... there's this special technique...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхе-хе! Вот так, вот так. А на финал... есть особая техника...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! I'm in heaven... !
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Я в раю...!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Thank... you... very much...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Большое... спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... very... good
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... очень... хорошо

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Ooops. I might have overdone it a little.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ...Упс. Кажется, я немного переборщила.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wouldn't say "a little"... But they look pretty happy, so I guess it's alright?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я бы не сказала «немного»... Но они выглядят довольно счастливыми, так что, думаю, ладно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Yeah, you're right! It's nice to do something good!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да, ты права! Приятно делать что-то хорошее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Good? ... That?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ...Хорошее? ...Это?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I am... very happy... Thank you...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я... очень счастлива... Спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... great
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... здорово

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... I don't think I'll ever risk getting a massage from Lydie.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ...Не думаю, что когда-нибудь рискну взять массаж у Лиди.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Plachta, hello.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Плахта, здравствуй.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Girls, good timing. In fact, perfect timing!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Девочки, как раз вовремя. Даже идеально вовремя!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I've got a request for you. Will you watch me synthesize?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: У меня просьба. Посмотрите, как я синтезирую?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Synthesize? But you said you couldn't do it before...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Синтезировать? Но ты говорила, что раньше не могла...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: That was because of my doll body.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Это было из-за кукольного тела.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Now I am human again, I should - in theory - be able to perform alchemy again...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Теперь я снова человек и теоретически снова должна уметь заниматься алхимией...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course! In which case, we'd love to watch you in action, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно! Тогда мы с радостью посмотрим на тебя в деле, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: We get to see 500 years of alchemy experience in action! I can't wait! Plachta, go ahead!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Мы увидим 500 лет алхимического опыта в действии! Не терпится! Плахта, вперёд!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Thank you. Listen to the desires of the materials, and change their properties. Remember...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Спасибо. Прислушайтесь к желаниям материалов и меняйте их свойства. Помните...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I did it! Success!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я сделала это! Успех!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Great! Congratulations! Not to mention the high quality...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Отлично! Поздравляем! Не говоря уже о высоком качестве...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: So this is your skill, Plachta? Uwah, I think I've got goosebumps!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Так вот каково твоё мастерство, Плахта? Ух, мурашки по коже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe, this takes me back. The feeling of creating something new. That raw thrill!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе, как же давно это было. Чувство создания чего-то нового. Этот чистый восторг!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been so long since I experienced this. Alchemy really is something special, isn't it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Так давно я этого не испытывала. Алхимия и правда нечто особенное, да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: You're right! Alchemy is fun!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Ты права! Алхимия — это весело!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been 500 years for you, hasn't it? That must make it feel even better!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Для тебя прошло 500 лет, да? От этого, наверное, ещё слаще!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It does. Now I can experience this again any time I want!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Да. Теперь я могу испытывать это снова, когда захочу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I owe Sophie even more gratitude, clearly. She has given me back something very dear to me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я ещё сильнее обязана Софи. Она вернула мне нечто очень дорогое.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe. You look so happy, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе. Ты выглядишь такой счастливой, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I'm glad, too. Please show us what you can do again soon!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я тоже рада. Пожалуйста, покажи нам снова скоро, на что способна!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course. Any time you like, girls, if that is all right with you. Thank you for today.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно. В любое время, девочки, если вам удобно. Спасибо за сегодня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been a while since I synthesized anything, but there's one thing I can't ignore from this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Давно я ничего не синтезировала, но есть одно, что нельзя игнорировать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: From the quality of this item, it's clear that my student surpassed me long ago...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: По качеству этой вещи ясно: моя ученица давно меня превзошла...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I think the time may have finally come...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Думаю, время наконец пришло...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie! Plachta! Do you want to play cards with us?...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи! Плахта! Хотите поиграть с нами в карты?...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Hold on. It looks like they are having some serious discussion...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Постой. Похоже, у них серьёзный разговор...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Alright, Plachta. What is it that you want to talk about?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Хорошо, Плахта. О чём ты хочешь поговорить?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Do you remember, Sophie, the goal that I once set for you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Помнишь, Софи, цель, которую я когда-то перед тобой поставила?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Of course. To surpass you as an alchemist, Plachta. What about it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Конечно. Превзойти тебя как алхимика, Плахта. И что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: I tried some synthesis recently. It was a success. I made an item without any trouble.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Недавно я попробовала синтез. Получилось. Сделала предмет без проблем.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Wow, you did? That's great, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Ого, правда? Это здорово, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Thank you. However, at the same time, I realized something. You have already well surpassed me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Спасибо. Однако одновременно я кое-что поняла. Ты уже давно меня превзошла.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Congratulations, Sophie. You have surpassed me as an alchemist.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Поздравляю, Софи. Ты превзошла меня как алхимик.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: As your friend, your family, and your teacher, I am so happy. You really have worked hard.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Как твоя подруга, твоя семья и твоя учительница — я так счастлива. Ты действительно много трудилась.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...Thank you. All that work has paid off...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Спасибо. Вся эта работа окупилась...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: But this doesn't mean things are going to change, right? We'll still be a student and a teacher?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Но это же не значит, что всё изменится, верно? Мы всё равно останемся ученицей и учительницей?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: No, we won't. In this moment, I think something has definitely changed.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Нет, не останемся. В этот момент, думаю, что-то определённо изменилось.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What do you mean?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
